task_description: Build a Python AI backend for LangkahKampus university admission predictor. Includes ML model training (XGBoost), FastAPI endpoints for prediction/recommendation/AI advisor, Fireworks AI integration for LLM-based explanations, Docker containerization with docker-compose orchestrating PHP frontend + Python backend + MySQL, and PHP integration layer with fallback to deterministic formula.

verification.summary: All 34 pytest tests pass (including new invalid score test). Both Docker images build successfully with project-root context. Review fixes applied: (1) SIDATA SQL now COPYed into container and volume-mounted at runtime, (2) CORS allow_credentials set to False, (3) ai-backend ports removed from docker-compose (internal only), (4) score validation with proper 422 errors, (5) circular training signal documented in train_model.py, (6) advisor message sanitization added.

review_fixes_applied: SIDATA SQL available in container via COPY and volume mount; config.py path resolution works in both contexts
CORS allow_credentials=False (PHP uses server-side cURL, not browser CORS)
Removed ports mapping for ai-backend (only accessible via internal Docker network)
Added try/except for float() score parsing returning 422 on invalid values
Added documentation comment in train_model.py about circular training limitation
Added message sanitization in advisor.py (truncation + injection pattern filtering)
